# TruffleHog path exclusions (regex, one per line).
# Scoped allowlist for documented placeholder credentials in starter examples.
# Real source is still scanned with --results=verified,unknown; only these
# example/placeholder files are exempt because they ship illustrative
# connection-string placeholders that trufflehog reports as unverified
# "unknown" results. These are not real secrets.
.*\.env\.example$
apps/starter-[^/]+/README\.md$
